summary: BUG FIX VERIFIED. Paywall now correctly displays $5.00 for the MONTHLY plan. Screenshot confirms MONTHLY price card reads '$5.00' and the paywall-purchase button reads 'SUBSCRIBE — $5.00'. RevenueCat rcbilling network response for pro.monthly returns amount_micros=5000000 ($5.00), confirming the RC-side recreation of the monthly product (prodf8cdb8e2a3) with the correct price propagated. Flow validated: login athlete@test.com / TestPass123! → ME (Profile) tab → tap MANAGE PREMIUM (open-paywall-profile) → paywall renders correct price. Annual product still returns amount_micros=79990000 ($79.99) as expected per revenuecat.md. No red screens, no blocking errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Console shows 'textShadow* style props are deprecated. Use textShadow.' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking the paywall fix but should be cleaned up. Look for legacy textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius style usages and any pointerEvents prop passed directly to components.

action_items: Bug fix verified — no further paywall action needed.
Optional cleanup: migrate deprecated 'textShadow*' style props to the single 'textShadow' prop and move pointerEvents into style objects to silence warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: paywall.tsx selects monthly explicitly via currentOffering.monthly / $rc_monthly / packageType MONTHLY — correct.
revenuecat.tsx correctly picks the RC Test Store API key on web/DEV and offerings are cached with 5-min staleTime; a fresh page load fetched updated pricing successfully.

rca_of_issue: Root cause was the RevenueCat Test-Store product price for pro.monthly still being $9.99 (iteration_1). The main agent DELETED and RECREATED the monthly product with a $5.00 price (new product id prodf8cdb8e2a3, amount_micros 5000000). The recreated price is now returned by the rcbilling products endpoint and rendered by paywall.tsx via pkg.product.priceString. Verified: (1) rcbilling GET /products?id=pro.monthly returns amount_micros:5000000, (2) UI MONTHLY card = '$5.00', (3) SUBSCRIBE button = 'SUBSCRIBE — $5.00'.
